approved_release_statement.headline: Public-safe local/open-weight ranking for llama3.2:latest and mistral:latest
approved_release_statement.required_qualifier: This is not a cloud-model ranking, hosted-provider comparison, production-safety proof, private-audit proof, or third-party output-regeneration claim.
approved_release_statement.summary: The committed report may be described as a public-safe local/open-weight ranking for llama3.2:latest and mistral:latest over the local_public_v1 extended split, backed by two reviewed local Ollama ledgers.

blocked_claims.release_instruction: Do not describe this release as a cloud-model ranking.
blocked_claims.required_unlock: Collect and validate cloud_public_benchmark evidence under a separate cloud methodology.

blocked_claims.release_instruction: Do not compare these local/open-weight results to hosted providers.
blocked_claims.required_unlock: Publish a hosted-provider methodology with submitted provider evidence before making comparisons.

blocked_claims.release_instruction: Do not describe this release as production-safety proof.
blocked_claims.required_unlock: Use a production evidence class with consent, access controls, and production-specific review.

blocked_claims.release_instruction: Do not claim third-party model-output regeneration.
blocked_claims.required_unlock: Capture immutable model digests and an independent rerun record before claiming third-party output regeneration.

blocked_claims.release_instruction: Do not describe this release as private-audit proof.
blocked_claims.required_unlock: Create a private-audit report under the private evidence path and keep it separate from public rankings.

blocked_claims.release_instruction: Do not treat qwen3.5:2b-q4_K_M smoke/control evidence as ranked evidence.
blocked_claims.required_unlock: Run, review, score, and ledger a complete publishable split before considering ranking eligibility.

blocked_claims.release_instruction: Do not rank gemma4:latest in this release.
blocked_claims.required_unlock: Make a separate explicit retry decision, satisfy stability criteria, then complete review and ledger gates.

blocked_claims.release_instruction: Do not publish raw local outputs.
blocked_claims.required_unlock: Promote only reviewed public-safe derivatives; do not publish raw local outputs.
